resources.string: Connect your own Telegram Bot API token to synchronize photos, videos, documents, audio, contacts, and calendar exports directly to authorized Telegram chats.
Telegram Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted by default. Enable local AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with unique 96-bit nonces before any byte leaves your device.
Uses zero-permission Photo Picker and Storage Access Framework. Contacts and Calendar require explicit opt-in consent. Bot tokens are hardware-backed via Android Keystore.
Displays real-time Telegram backup and restoration progress
